capabilities: Style Mermaid diagrams with color palettes, typography, and spacing without editing source
Replace the default Dagre layout with automatic ELK layout
Configure per-diagram-type styles or keep native rendering
Copy and export diagrams as SVG or PNG
Refresh enhanced rendering via command when diagrams look unchanged
disambiguation: Not just a color theme; it also replaces Mermaid's default Dagre layout with automatic ELK layout and adds diagram export.
extras: Bundled renderer is about 6 MB, above Obsidian Sync Standard's 5 MB file limit, so it must be installed separately on each device; mobile devices are untested. Explicit source styles take precedence, and it can conflict with other plugins that replace Mermaid rendering.
intentEvidence: Works with your existing mermaid blocks, without editing the source.
problem: Native Mermaid rendering in Obsidian uses default styling and the Dagre layout, producing cluttered diagrams that usually require editing diagram source to improve.

relations.evidence: leaves the bottom-right corner for Mermaid Zoom

summary: Mermaid diagram renderer and themer that restyles existing Mermaid blocks with palettes, ELK layout, per-type settings, and SVG/PNG export.
